text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Crossing the finish line in first feels 
amazing! That's why I can never give up 
racing~!"
choice_data_list: Let's win the next race, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! I'm super satisfied that I got to 
show off my cool side!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I'll give you front-row seats to watch me 
keep racking up wins, so look forward to 
it♪"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll work hard in training and 
show you I can win next time too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Of course! And for that very reason, we've 
gotta aim even higher!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
First, let's look back on today's race and 
see what went well and what didn't!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I definitely want to take 1st place next 
time too, so I won't let my guard down and 
keep trying my best, hmph!"
